about: Generated art for the website: key art, store capsules, share cards, logo lockups. Not game captures: each is shown only as a labelled illustration (or, for a logo or wordmark, where nobody reads it as gameplay). Prompts are in docs/key-art-prompts.md; tools/website-check.mjs enforces the fields and where the art may appear.

format.file: file name in website/art/, e.g. key-art-16x9.jpg
format.use: key-art | capsule | social-card | logo | wordmark | illustration
format.tool: what made it, e.g. ChatGPT (GPT image), with any finishing tool after it
format.prompt: the exact prompt used, plus any follow-up edits asked for
format.source: the game capture attached as reference, e.g. review-media/landscape-pnw.jpg (null only for a logo or wordmark)
format.sha256: hash of the file as committed (shasum -a 256 website/art/<file>)
format.notes: optional: crop, resize, who approved it

art.prompt: The attached images are from my game "Second Growth": its current detailed badge (a young fir growing from an old cut stump by a creek) and my website's header, which uses a simple flat silhouette of that idea. Design 8 alternative flat logo marks for the same idea, new growth rising from old damage: a young conifer sprouting from a tree stump, seen simply. Clean geometric shapes, one colour only (soft fern green #b7d494 on a dark pine green #102019 background), readable at 16 pixels, no gradients, no outlines, no text, no extra scenery. Calm, natural and quietly confident, like the mark of a thoughtful independent nature studio. Show all 8 on one sheet in a grid. (the prompt as written in docs/key-art-prompts.md; any follow-ups were not recorded)
art.notes: Eight flat marks. No. 2 (top row, second: a fir from a stump with growth rings) was redrawn by Claude as website/mark.svg and website/favicon.svg.

art.prompt: Using the attached badge from my game "Second Growth" as the reference for the subject, redesign it as a modern app icon: a rounded square with a young Douglas-fir rising from an old cut stump with visible growth rings, a strip of creek and a low sun. Soft, simple shapes in the game's own gentle low-poly style, with at most one soft gradient: simple enough to recognise at 48 pixels, rich enough to enjoy at 512. Palette: dark pine green #102019 and moss #1b3128 behind, soft fern green #b7d494 for the young tree, a warm sun #e8bf7a, creek blue-green #63bdf6, the stump in warm brown and cream. No text, no border, no drop shadow outside the square. Show 4 options. (the prompt as written in docs/key-art-prompts.md; any follow-ups were not recorded)
art.notes: The new app icon. Cropped just inside its rounded square into assets/icon-512.png, icon-192.png, icon-180.png, website/apple-touch-icon.png and art/app-icon-1024.png.

art.prompt: The name "Second Growth" set in a friendly modern grotesque in the style of Bricolage Grotesque at a medium weight, slightly tight letter spacing, cream #fbf6e7 on dark pine green #102019. Give it one small, quiet detail drawn from the logo: a tiny fir sprouting from the dot or the end of one letter, in fern #b7d494. Calm, not flashy. Show 4 options. Spell it exactly: Second Growth. (the prompt as written in docs/key-art-prompts.md; any follow-ups were not recorded)
